name: facebookresearch_codellama/llama/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_codellama/llama/generat.build_Llama: build a Llama model instance from checkpoint directory and tokenizer path with model parallel support
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/generat.generate_Llama_generate: generate token sequences from prompt tokens using temperature sampling and top-p nucleus sampling
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/generat.complete_Llama_text_completion: complete text prompts by generating continuations with configurable temperature and top-p parameters
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/generat.infill_Llama_text_infilling: infill missing text between a prefix and suffix using the Llama infilling model
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/generat.chat_Llama_chat_completion: complete a multi-turn chat dialog with system user and assistant message roles

facebookresearch_codellama/llama/model.p.build_transformer_model: build a Llama transformer model using ModelArgs to configure dim, layers, heads, and vocab size
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/model.p.run_transformer_forward: run the transformer forward pass with token tensors and a start position for inference
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/model.p.create_modelargs_config: create a ModelArgs dataclass to configure the Llama model dimensions, layers, and sequence length
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/model.p.apply_rotary_embedding: apply rotary positional embeddings to query and key tensors using precomputed freqs_cis
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/model.p.build_rmsnorm_layer: build an RMSNorm layer to normalize tensor inputs with configurable dimension and epsilon

facebookresearch_codellama/llama/tokeniz.create_tokenizer: create a Tokenizer instance by loading a SentencePiece model from a model file path
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/tokeniz.encode_text: encode a string into a list of token IDs with optional BOS and EOS tokens
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/tokeniz.decode_tokens: decode a list of token IDs back into a human-readable string
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/tokeniz.encode_infilling: encode a string into token IDs without an implicit leading space for infilling tasks
facebookresearch_codellama/llama/tokeniz.token_piece_lookup: look up the string piece representation of a single token ID
